scope: Bilingual guidance. Does not imply universal automatic imports or endorsement.

online.zh: 公開議題 brief，開放改寫問題。
online.en: Publish a brief and invite people to reframe it.

offline.zh: 與受影響的人走訪現場，確認誰有決定權。
offline.en: Walk the site with affected people and identify decision makers.

input.zh: 待解決的問題、權限與限制

output.zh: 可修改的議題 brief ＋ 回覆承諾

gate.zh: 誰能決定？哪些事真的可以改變？
gate.en: Who can decide? What is actually open to change?

next.zh: 權限不清楚，先留在這一步；確認後再招募。
next.en: Stay here if authority is unclear; recruit once it is explicit.

online.zh: 表單收集參與意願與可近用需求，聯絡資訊分開保存。
online.en: Collect availability and access needs; store contacts separately.

offline.zh: 電話、街訪、照顧與交通支持，讓未上線的人能加入。
offline.en: Use calls, street outreach, care and travel support to include people offline.

input.zh: 受影響社群、既有參與缺口

output.zh: 志願者池 ＋ 缺席聲音清單

gate.zh: 哪些人因設備、時間、語言而進不來？
gate.en: Who is excluded by devices, time or language?

next.zh: 人沒有到齊時，補招募；不要用更多投票掩蓋缺席。
next.en: Recruit missing voices before relying on more votes.

online.zh: 需要小型代表性小組時，公開配額與抽樣方法。
online.en: For a representative panel, publish quotas and the selection method.

offline.zh: 確認出席、候補與支持需求；也可採開放參與。
offline.en: Confirm attendance, replacements and access support; open participation is also possible.

input.zh: 志願者池、配額、參與條件
input.en: Volunteer pool, quotas and access conditions

output.zh: 正選／候補 ＋ 抽樣限制

gate.zh: 自願報名不等於代表性抽樣。這一輪需要抽樣嗎？
gate.en: Volunteers are not a representative sample. Does this round need sortition?

next.zh: 開放諮詢可略過；需要抽樣時使用專門工具並人工覆核。
next.en: Skip for open consultation; use a dedicated sortition tool and human review for panels.

online.zh: 分享有來源的資料、理解檢核與可補充的問題池。
online.en: Share sourced material, understanding checks and an open question pool.

offline.zh: 平衡資訊說明、專家問答與小組討論，讓參與者能更正。
offline.en: Balance briefings, expert Q&A and small groups; invite corrections.

input.zh: 議題 brief、證據與相反觀點

output.zh: 證據包 ＋ 問題與更正紀錄

gate.zh: 大家理解的是同一件事嗎？資料能不能查證？
gate.en: Are people discussing the same issue? Can evidence be checked?

next.zh: 出現共同誤解就補資料、再學習，不急著表決。
next.en: Return to learning when shared misconceptions appear.

online.zh: 用訪談與陳述投票收集經驗，允許補充、略過與撤回。
online.en: Use interviews and statement voting; allow additions, passes and withdrawal.

offline.zh: 小圈聆聽、均等發言，經同意再將逐字內容帶到線上。
offline.en: Make space for every speaker; digitize stories only with consent.

output.zh: 有來源的原話 ＋ 陳述池

gate.zh: 原話是否被正確理解？少數聲音是否仍看得見？
gate.en: Were people understood correctly? Are minority voices still visible?

next.zh: 讓參與者校對整理，再把可討論的選項帶往審議。
next.en: Invite participant correction before turning stories into options.

online.zh: 找跨群接受的陳述、修訂提案、比較理由與預算取捨。
online.en: Find bridging statements, amend proposals and compare reasons and budget trade-offs.

offline.zh: 小組交換理由、提問與修案；保留尚未化解的分歧。
offline.en: Exchange reasons and revise proposals in small groups; retain unresolved disagreement.

output.zh: 可推進方案 ＋ 歧見與方法限制
output.en: Workable options + dissent and method limitations

gate.zh: 高分代表什麼？誰沒投票？少數意見去了哪裡？
gate.en: What does a score mean? Who did not vote? Where is dissent?

next.zh: 選項不完整回到聆聽；資料不足回到學習。
next.en: Return to listening for missing options or learning for missing evidence.

online.zh: 逐項連回原話，分開整理、人工解讀與正式回應。
online.en: Link back to sources and separate synthesis, human interpretation and official response.

offline.zh: 請有權回應者說明採納理由、負責者與期限。
offline.en: Ask decision makers to explain acceptance, ownership and deadlines.

input.zh: 審議結果、分歧與未回答問題

output.zh: 有責任人與期限的成果收據

gate.zh: 每個問題都有回覆嗎？沒採納也有理由嗎？
gate.en: Has every question received a response, including reasons for rejection?

next.zh: 尚未回答的問題保留為下一輪輸入，不能用摘要消失。
next.en: Carry unanswered questions into the next round.

online.zh: 開放更正、追蹤承諾，帶著來源與版本開始下一輪。
online.en: Invite corrections, track commitments and carry source links into the next version.

offline.zh: 回到社群檢視改變，邀請缺席的人參與下一輪。
offline.en: Return to the community, review change and invite people who were missing.

input.zh: 成果收據、修正與參與缺口

output.zh: 下一輪 brief ＋ 明確回到哪一步
output.en: Next-round brief + an explicit return point

gate.zh: 改變了什麼？誰還沒有被聽見？下一次何時回覆？
gate.en: What changed? Who is still missing? When is the next response?

next.zh: 依缺口選下一步：補人、補知識、修方案或追蹤執行。
next.en: Choose the return point: people, evidence, options or implementation.

description.zh: 把報名、需求與意見接到下一個工具。
description.en: Pass sign-ups, needs and comments to the next tool.

description.zh: 逐個聽見經驗，留下可整理的訪談。
description.en: Hear individual experience and export interviews.

description.zh: 陳述、投票、分群與跨群橋接排序。
description.en: Statements, voting, groups and bridging ranks.

description.zh: 讓現場與遠端參與者一起提問。
description.en: Bring questions from the room and remote participants together.

tools.name: Pocket TTTC

description.zh: 保留引文來源，從原話走到主題。
description.en: Move from quotations to themes with source links.

tools.overlap: Talk to the City / Deliberative Canvas

description.zh: 把問題連回回覆，交代誰負責下一步。
description.en: Connect questions to responses and next-step owners.

description.zh: 讓選項能被提問、支持與修正。
看清理由的結構，保留反方論點。
description.en: Explore the structure of reasons and counterarguments.

description.zh: 在成本限制內比較支持度與公平。
description.en: Compare support and fairness under a cost constraint.

description.zh: 從小量選項找出下一步優先順序。
description.en: Prioritize a small set of options through pairwise choices.

description.zh: 發現理解缺口，回到證據與說明。
description.en: Find understanding gaps and return to the evidence.

description.zh: 對話、價值卡與價值之間的比較。
description.en: Explore dialogue, value cards and comparisons.

description.zh: 把書面立場連到議程與公開紀錄。
description.en: Connect written positions with agendas and public records.

principle.zh: 先讓人被理解，再讓資料被整理。

detail.zh: 把小組聆聽、原話溯源與人類判讀放在摘要之前；分類仍須讓參與者修正。
detail.en: Put small-group listening, traceable voices and human sensemaking before summaries; invite participant corrections.

principle.zh: 從小圈對話，走向可聽見的公共聲音。
principle.en: Connect small conversations to public listening.

detail.zh: 招募信任的在地伙伴，留意缺席群體，公開引文前確認授權。數位彙整不能取代關係與主持。
detail.en: Work with trusted local partners, notice missing groups and confirm permission to share quotes. Facilitation and relationships still matter.

principle.zh: 讓受影響者參與設定問題與評估選項。
principle.en: Let affected people shape questions and evaluate options.

detail.zh: 開放補充選項、公開取捨與方法限制；將 AI 輔助分析交還人來檢查。
detail.en: Invite new options, expose trade-offs and method limitations, and return AI-assisted analysis to people for review.

principle.zh: 把參與空間當作需要照顧的公共場所。
principle.en: Care for participation as a public space.

detail.zh: 先寫共同規範、主持與申訴方式，讓新人敢進來、不同立場能持續相遇。
detail.en: Make norms, facilitation and appeals visible so newcomers can join and different perspectives can keep meeting.

principle.zh: 依需求組合工具，讓資料跨過工具邊界。
principle.en: Compose tools around needs and connect their data.

detail.zh: 功能可以跳步與重複；每次交接標示輸入、輸出、轉換損失與下一位負責者。
detail.en: Functions can repeat or be skipped; label inputs, outputs, conversion loss and the next responsible person.

principle.zh: 提供平衡資訊與討論條件，再比較意見。
principle.en: Provide balanced information and discussion before comparing views.

detail.zh: 抽樣、均等發言、專家問答與前後測各有用途；開放網路投票不能宣稱代表全體。
detail.en: Sampling, equal voice, expert Q&A and pre/post measures serve distinct purposes; open online voting is not population representation.

principle.zh: 理解 → 意見 → 綜整，再回到理解。

detail.zh: 把議題帶到自己的 AI，帶回摘要與判斷；將前一輪成果整理為下一輪共讀材料。
detail.en: Take the issue to your own AI and bring back a summary and judgment; turn previous findings into shared material for the next round.

principle.zh: 每一個問題，都有可追溯的回覆。
principle.en: Give each question a traceable response.

detail.zh: Agent 先讀規格、準備可檢查的草稿，再由人確認發布；不把整理稿當成正式決定。
detail.en: Agents read contracts and prepare inspectable drafts; humans review publication and distinguish synthesis from official decisions.
